person.note:
Godwin sees him in circles with Lanesborough, King, Moira and others and on his trip to Ireland. He had also seen a certain amount of Lady Granard in 1799 at King's in London (coded GRA07): 1799-06-21; 1799-11-17; 1800-08-09. .
See Ed Pope's comment:George Forbes 1760-1837 6th Earl Granard (his will PCC 1837 general, died at Paris, his stepmother (d.1820) married Rev Samuel Little) married 10.5.1779 Lady Selina Frances Rawdon, 4th dau of John 1st Earl of Moira, she died 1827. Godwin often lapsed into using a plain surname for females (and in many cases, usually of female authors, used the plain surname from the first meeting) so it's hard to tell if the plain Granard entries referred to Lady Granard or her husband. She featured in his 1796 list and he didn't.
